claim: The PR adds `public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.Commutator.Basic` to `Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Pointwise.lean`, but nothing in Pointwise.lean uses commutators. The lemma the PR touches there moved *out* of the file into `Subgroup/Basic.lean`, which Pointwise already imports. So the new import is unused, and it makes Pointwise (and everything downstream of it) depend on `Commutator.Basic` and hence `QuotientGroup.Defs`.
requested_change: Delete the line `public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.Commutator.Basic` from the imports of `Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Pointwise.lean`.

claim: `commutator_sup_left` and its private helper `commutator_sup_left'` are the only new commutator lemmas in the PR without `@[to_additive]`. The file tags essentially every `Subgroup` commutator lemma with it, including the PR's own `commutator_mono_left`, `commutator_mono_right` and `commutator_le_of_le`, so `AddSubgroup` gets no version of the distributivity result.
requested_change: Add `@[to_additive]` to `commutator_sup_left` and to the private `commutator_sup_left'` it uses. This generates `AddSubgroup.addCommutator_sup_left`.

claim: `commutator_sup_right` lacks `@[to_additive]`, unlike its neighbours in the file, so there is no `AddSubgroup` version of `⁅N, H ⊔ K⁆ = ⁅N, H⁆ ⊔ ⁅N, K⁆`.
requested_change: Add `@[to_additive]` to `commutator_sup_right`, together with the same attribute on `commutator_sup_left`, which it uses. This generates `AddSubgroup.addCommutator_sup_right`.

claim: The PR tags only the one-sided lemmas `commutator_mono_left` and `commutator_mono_right` with `gcongr`. The two-sided `commutator_mono` stays untagged, and gcongr looks lemmas up by exactly which arguments vary, so `gcongr` cannot close `⁅A, C⁆ ≤ ⁅B, D⁆` when both arguments change.
requested_change: Also tag the existing `commutator_mono` with `@[to_additive (attr := gcongr)]`, so gcongr/grw handle the case where both arguments vary as well as the one-sided cases the PR covers.

claim: The proof of `commutator_sup_left` detours through the quotient `(H ⊔ K ⊔ N) ⧸ (⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆)`. That needs a separate private helper `commutator_sup_left'`, five `have`s for containment in `M`, `subgroupOf` transport with `convert`, and two large `simp` calls. The key fact it establishes, that `H ⊔ K` normalises `⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆`, already gives the result by closure induction on `H ⊔ K`, with the existing `commutatorElement_mul_left_eq_conj_mul` and `commutatorElement_inv_left` identities.
requested_change:
Prove `commutator_sup_left` directly and delete the private `commutator_sup_left'`:
theorem commutator_sup_left (H K N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] : ⁅H ⊔ K, N⁆ = ⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆ := by
  refine le_antisymm ?_
    (sup_le (commutator_mono_left le_sup_left) (commutator_mono_left le_sup_right))
  have hX : ⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆ ≤ N := sup_le (commutator_le_right H N) (commutator_le_right K N)
  have hHK : H ⊔ K ≤ normalizer (⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆ : Subgroup G) := sup_le
    (by grw [le_normalizer_iff_commutator_le_right, hX, ← le_sup_left])
    (by grw [le_normalizer_iff_commutator_le_right, hX, ← le_sup_right])
  rw [sup_eq_closure H K] at hHK
  rw [commutator_le]
  intro g hg
  rw [sup_eq_closure H K] at hg
  induction hg using closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · exact fun n hn ↦ mem_sup_left (commutator_mem_commutator hx hn)
    · exact fun n hn ↦ mem_sup_right (commutator_mem_commutator hx hn)
  | one => simp
  | mul x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
    intro n hn
    rw [commutatorElement_mul_left_eq_conj_mul]
    exact mul_mem ((mem_normalizer_iff.mp (hHK hx) _).mp (ihy n hn)) (ihx n hn)
  | inv x hx ihx =>
    intro n hn
    rw [commutatorElement_inv_left, ← commutatorElement_inv]
    exact (mem_normalizer_iff''.mp (hHK hx) _).mp (inv_mem (ihx n hn))

claim: The PR moves the binary `inf_normalizer_le_normalizer_sup` into `Subgroup/Basic.lean`, next to `inf_normalizer_le_normalizer_inf` and `iInf_normalizer_le_normalizer_iInf`. Its indexed counterpart `iInf_normalizer_le_normalizer_iSup` stays behind in `Pointwise.lean`, so the sup pair is now split across files while the inf pair sits together.
requested_change: Move `iInf_normalizer_le_normalizer_iSup` from `Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Pointwise.lean` to `Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Basic.lean`, directly after `inf_normalizer_le_normalizer_sup`. Its proof is unchanged, and `iSup_normal` in Pointwise still finds it through the existing import.
